20: Women are patur: because it is a mitzvah aseh shehazman grama. And even though they fulfill all the mitzvot aseh like Sukkah, nonetheless they do not fulfill this one, because they caused the moon to wane (Shelah) see what he wrote at the end of #296. And in Sanhedrin ch. 5 it says regarding blessing the moon “our women also make this blessing”, somewhat implying that they make the blessing, but possibly this is a figure of speech.
